answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Cart gauger elm hub seal sworn before the wheel shop bench — each elm hub is a measured wheel yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must gauge. The gate charges per key: 104 POA per key, 429 keys, 44616 POA total, collected before the first answer. A plume that lapses, a ivory that recurs, and a timber that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
